column1: # Written against this project's actual vocabulary rather than the generic
# template, which knew nothing about probes, grading or admission and sent
# "the endpoint returns a 500 on the results page" to the frontend.
# Read top-down. Highest score wins and file order breaks ties, so the failure
# routes sit above the subsystem routes: something being broken says more about
# what to do next than which subsystem it is broken in.
# Words you typed count double, words from the branch and working tree count
# single. Note that tokens shorter than four characters are dropped, so an HTTP
# status like 500 can never be a keyword.
